author: ValWood
body:
* **InterPro ID / label**


GO:0006893 | Golgi to plasma membrane transport | IEA with IPR029175


* **Example sequences with problematic annotation (ID + gene/protein name):**

https://www.pombase.org/gene/SPCC622.10c
exocyst complex subunit
(and homologs)

* **Description of issue**

exocyst is involved in exocytosis rather than Golgi to plasma membrane transport.
Golgi to plasma membrane transport precedes exocytosis.
title: InterPro2GO issue: GO:0006893 | Golgi to plasma membrane transport
